title: The Kwong-Wai-Shiu Free Hospital (Transfer of Undertaking and Dissolution) Bill
what_it_is: The Kwong-Wai-Shiu Free Hospital (Transfer of Undertaking and Dissolution) Bill

sections.label: Largest nursing home facility
sections.summary: When fully opened, it will have more than 600 beds and be Singapore's largest nursing home facility.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: When fully opened, it will have more than 600 beds and will be the largest nursing home facility in Singapore.

sections.label: Ordinance restricts Kwong Wai Shiu role
sections.summary: The Ordinance restricts Kwong Wai Shiu's role to hospital services for indigent persons from three Canton Province prefectures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: The Ordinance restricts Kwong Wai Shiu's role to provide hospital services for "indigent persons connected with the Kwong-Chau, Wai-Chau and Shiu-heng prefectures of the Canton Province of China", hence, the name "Kwong Wai Shiu Hospital".

sections.label: Bill transfers assets to CLG
sections.summary: The Bill transfers all assets, rights and liabilities of Kwong Wai Shiu to the new CLG, which has a new constitution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: The Bill will transfer all the assets, rights and liabilities of Kwong Wai Shiu to the new CLG.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: A new constitution has been established for the CLG, under which there are clear guidelines for governance and the avoidance of conflicts of interest.

sections.label: Records and obligations transferred
sections.summary: Upon transfer, all records, legal rights and obligations of the former Kwong Wai Shiu are transferred to and assumed by the CLG.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: Upon the transfer, all records, legal rights and obligations of the former Kwong Wai Shiu will be transferred to, and assumed by, the CLG.

sections.label: Objective of Kwong Wai Shiu Bill
sections.summary: The Bill aims to help Kwong Wai Shiu modernise its corporate structure and provide healthcare with transparency and accountability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: The objective of the Kwong Wai Shiu Bill is to support Kwong Wai Shiu to modernise its corporate structure and place the hospital in a stronger position with greater flexibility to provide healthcare services to Singaporeans, while ensuring transparency and accountability.

sections.label: MOH supports abolishing antiquated regulations
sections.summary: MOH supports the hospital in abolishing antiquated regulations and widening its charitable affairs, hence raising the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: MOH supports the hospital in moving in step with the times, to abolish those antiquated regulations and to widen the scope of its charitable affairs, hence, raising the Bill for the transfer of undertaking and dissolution.

sections.label: KWSH services and land lease
sections.summary: From 1974 KWSH provided healthcare to all races and set up centres for low-income elderly; after its 2010 lease expiry it stayed at the original location.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Actually, from 1974 onwards, KWSH has already provided healthcare services for Singaporeans of all races; the hospital has also established an inpatient centre, rehabilitation centre and community hospitals to look after the needs of low-income elderly patients.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: After the expiry of Kwong Wai Shiu's land lease in 2010, the Urban Redevelopment Authority and the hospital authorities came together for an earnest discussion and came to an amicable solution of letting it remain at the original location.

sections.label: New Bill and KWSH governance
sections.summary: The new Bill gives KWSH flexibility to help more low-income Singaporeans, removes Ordinance limits on beneficiaries, and allows a modern governance structure with greater transparency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: With the new Bill, KWSH will have more flexibility to help more low-income Singaporeans regardless of race or religion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: This will remove the limitations imposed by the Ordinance regarding KWSH's beneficiaries and allow it to adopt a modern governance structure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Changes to its governance structure will also be in the interest of KWSH's donors and beneficiaries as the hospital will have greater transparency and accountability in fulfilling its mandate.

sections.label: Funding and launch date questions
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether funding will be provided for the new entity's operations and whether the launch date is on track.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can I ask if it will also be providing the funding for the operations of this new entity?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could the Minister of State provide an update on whether or not we are on track for the date of launch?

sections.label: Tracheostomy patients waiting for beds
sections.summary: Patients needing tracheostomy care often wait up to a year for available beds while in acute hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For example, this includes patients who require tracheostomy care.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Such patients are often left to wait for available beds for up to a year while in the acute hospitals.

sections.label: Transfer of KWSH records and rights
sections.summary: Under the Bill, the former Kwong Wai Shiu's records, legal rights and obligations transfer seamlessly to the new CLG, which continues its nursing home and MOH funding.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As mentioned earlier, under this Bill, all records, legal rights and obligations of the former Kwong Wai Shiu will be transferred to, and assumed by, the new CLG, in a seamless manner.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This means that the "new" Kwong Wai Shiu will continue to run its nursing home and receive the same funding from MOH to care for its clients.

sections.label: Board leadership and facility completion
sections.summary: The speaker is confident board members will lead KWSH as it expands, and the new 12-storey facility is on track for completion in end-2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I am confident that the board members will continue to lead and guide Kwong Wai Shiu as it expands its mandate and infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I would also like to take this opportunity to update that the new 12-storey facility is on track for completion in end-2017.

sections.label: MOH support for Kwong Wai Shiu Bill
sections.summary: MOH will work with Kwong Wai Shiu and other partners to improve ILTC care accessibility and quality in Singapore, and asks the House to support the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Moving forward, MOH will continue to work closely with Kwong Wai Shiu, as well as other like-minded partners to continue improving the accessibility and quality of ILTC care for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Together, we will make Singapore an ideal place to age gracefully in.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I call on Members of the House to give their support to the Kwong Wai Shiu Bill.

sections.label: Select Committee on Bill
sections.summary: The Select Committee received one written representation, made only textual alterations changing the citation year from 2016 to 2017, and presented its Report on 15 February 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: The Select Committee received one written representation, which was assessed not to directly concern the subject matter of the Bill.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: The Select Committee has considered the Bill and has only made textual alterations to the Bill to reflect the change in citation year from 2016 to 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: The Committee's Report was presented to Members of the House on 15 February 2017.
